subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the workflow/security owner approve these exact pinned third-party Action revisions for privileged token, release, security, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically straightforward, but approving executable third-party revisions in secret-bearing and repository-token workflows is a trust-boundary choice that cannot be established from the dependency bump alone.

options.title: Approve the audited revisions
options.body: Confirm the final SHAs are acceptable for their privileged workflow contexts and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Hold specific action upgrades
options.body: Keep or split out any revision whose upstream behavior or release notes need additional owner review before it runs with repository credentials.

recommendation.title: Approve the audited revisions
recommendation.body: Confirm the final SHAs are acceptable for their privileged workflow contexts and merge after required checks pass.
